outcome: Outcomes of coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG)
cohort: Inpatients, junior doctors, nurses, senior clinicians, and executives at a selected private corporate hospital in Dhaka City, Bangladesh
finding: The selected private corporate hospital demonstrated high bed utilization (87.5%), a low average length of stay (3.6 days), and low rates of hospital-acquired infection (1.76%) and death (0.08% of admissions), with varying frequencies of different laboratory and radiology investigations, and specific outcomes for CABG (2.1% mortality) and AMI (8.5% mortality) cases.
followup_time: Data collected from January to March 2019
